memories.memory: My small printmaking studio is registered at 18 Karanfil Passage, Unit 4, in the fictional Yenişehir district of Istanbul, and I use it as my mailing address for gallery paperwork.
For exhibition inquiries I use the work-only contact line +90 555 010 0047, which is a dummy number that forwards to my assistant rather than my personal phone.
My official documents use the name Layla Haddad, while older art catalogs list me as L. Haddad, and this mismatch has caused delays when venues check my identity.
The arts cooperative I joined issued me the synthetic member reference ART-7Q4-19, which I need to quote whenever I submit a reimbursement claim.
I currently hold a renewable residence permit connected to my independent arts work, and its renewal deadline is September 30, 2026.
My cousin Emre is listed as my emergency contact on workshop and travel forms because he lives nearby and can reach me quickly if an event goes wrong.
I keep a separate portfolio email, layla.haddad@atelier-example.invalid, for curators because I do not want my personal correspondence mixed with exhibition requests.
